column1: # Third-party files of the art pass (docs/ROADMAP.md, "Art pass (pre-stream)"),
# fetched and checked by scripts/fetch_assets.sh (`just fetch-assets`). One
# tab-separated row per remote file; see the script's header for the columns.
# dest `-` keeps a tool-only input (red KayKit variants for `inspect_gltf
# swatches`, character sources for `inspect_gltf bake`) in the download cache;
# every other row is vendored under assets/ byte for byte (scripts/check_assets.sh
# checks each one against its sha256 offline, in CI) and has its own
# Only raw.githubusercontent.com is reachable from the agent's VM (github.com,
# its API and codeload refuse), so files are pinned by sha256, not by commit.
